meta.name: aed:lightbox
meta.description: Optional auto-mode. Set content to 'auto' or 'all' to make every image inside `data-scope` lightbox-clickable without per-image markup.

data-scope.description: CSS selector for the auto-opt-in container.

data.description: Per-image opt-in (used when auto-mode is off, or for images outside the auto-scope).

data-aed-lightbox.description: Marker. Optional value = URL of a higher-resolution version to show in the lightbox; empty/omitted = use the image's own src.

data-aed-lightbox-caption.description: Caption shown beneath the lightbox image. Falls back to the image's alt text.

data-aed-lightbox-group.description: Group name. Images sharing a group are navigable as a gallery (prev/next). Defaults to all images on the page.
